case: PRODUCTION boot order: wire_spark_engine before start_local
reason: Boot re-arm refuses the 4th/5th Service rule when the compensating-disarm reservation is exhausted (log line: 'compensating-disarm reservation exhausted'). Exercised only at prefer_spark=true; 0.14.x production runs prefer_spark=false (legacy IGuard backend), so the refusal is not production-reachable on this line. Fixed on dev by PR #5184 (park and redrive), deliberately not back-ported to the 0.14.x hotfix line (1.2k product lines in guardian_spark_runtime). Remove when 0.15.0 is promoted to main.
